public_payload.normalized_proposition: There is no secret $150 billion government bailout for OpenAI or the AI industry.

statement.excerpt: No, there is not some mysterious $150 billion bailout.

our_interpretation: This denies an existing government rescue arrangement of approximately $150 billion benefiting OpenAI or the AI industry at publication.
The US government is inferred from the surrounding references to Trump and government loans.
The target is the arrangement's existence on August 18, 2026, rather than spending during a reporting quarter.
A proposal, ordinary procurement contract, private financing round, or company valuation does not by itself constitute a bailout.
No accounting basis or financial instrument is identified.
criteria.support_condition: Authoritative records or disclosures addressing the alleged arrangement establish that no such rescue had been authorized or agreed at publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Authenticated agreements, appropriations, guarantees, or subsequent disclosures establish that a qualifying $150 billion government rescue arrangement existed at publication.
